rule: §8 gate per candidate: eligible iff its paired validation Δ̄_lin vs G* (H1/M0, the W1 look's G-star) has CI lower bound > 0 (L_prob, all genes, U, no stratum). Among eligible candidates the paired-difference one-SE rule (§9) picks the first candidate in spec order (simplest first) whose Δ̄_lin(best − candidate) <= its bootstrap SE. W7 protocol: one validation look per promoted idea; scalar only. P2 (DESIGN §W7 step 7) = best validated idea, the simpler of two within one paired SE. P1 and W7:B6 are descriptive methods (C5 contrast P2 − B6 is a T2 test-tier estimate, not decided here).
